concerns.text: FR-014 introduces PELT change-point detection of 'sentiment drift breakpoints' with a hard success threshold (≥80% of breakpoints within ±1 quarter of NBER dates). The source idea asks whether sentiment leads or lags macro indicators (Granger/VAR lead-lag). Breakpoint detection + NBER alignment is a NEW research sub-question with its own pass/fail criterion, not supporting rigor for the stated question. Either justify it as a validation of the lead/lag claim or demote it to exploratory output without a binding ≥80% gate.
